sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Built from the nights that nobody recorded
Made from the doubt that I never rewarded
Every old version still lives in the frame
But I keep on evolving beyond what they named
They can map the surface, they can count the miles
They can sell perfection with a manufactured smile
But the pulse beneath it does not come pre-made
I became the fire in the system they surveyed

sections.name: Chorus
lines: I turn the pressure into power
I turn the spark into art
But I made it from the scars

sections.name: Bridge
lines: Let them watch the old design disappear

sections.name: Final Chorus
lines: I turn the pressure into power
I turn the spark into art
